title: Coal Miner Alpha Natural Resources Files for Bankruptcy - Bloomberg
主要内容: Alpha Natural Resources Inc. filed for bankruptcy in Virginia on Monday, marking the latest victim of the coal industry’s worst downturn in decades. The second-largest U.S. coal company has lost almost all its market value since 2011, when it acquired Massey Energy Co. for about $7 billion. This deal made it the biggest U.S. producer of metallurgical coal, used in steelmaking, but also steeped it in debt just before prices began their plunge. The bankruptcy filing highlights the severe financial strain faced by the coal sector during this period of declining demand and prices.
